description.zh: 归属ID（网站ID或阿里云用户ID）
description.en: The owner ID, which can be a website ID or an Alibaba Cloud account ID.

The type of the owner ID. Valid values:
- siteId
- uid.

description.zh: 订单模块信息（为空时，espBizId和bizType不能为空）
description.en: The order module information. If this parameter is empty, espBizId and bizType cannot be empty.

description.zh: 资源值，默认为空，只有是功能类资源才需要，0不支持，1支持
description.en:
The resource value. This parameter is empty by default and is required only for feature-type resources. Valid values:
- 0: not supported
- 1: supported.

descriptions.zh: 查询资源对应的supabase实例信息
descriptions.en: Queries the Supabase instance information corresponding to a resource.
